news_items.headline: TSMC stock surges +6% to fresh 52-week high after AMD Q1 blowout earnings
news_items.summary: TSM rallied +6% to $418.03 on May 6 after AMD reported Q1 2026 revenue of $10.3B (+38% YoY, beat by 4%+). TSMC is AMD's primary foundry partner for AI accelerators and server CPUs.

news_items.headline: Why is Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing stock surging today?
news_items.summary: Sector-wide semiconductor rally ignited by AMD's Q1 2026 earnings beat lifted TSM to a new 52-week high; AI chip demand visibility for TSMC fab utilization improved.

news_items.headline: A Step Forward That TSMC Stock Investors Shouldn't Miss
news_items.summary: TSMC said 2nm chip capacity will grow at a 70% CAGR from 2026 through 2028, with 5 fabs (2 in Hsinchu, 3 in Kaohsiung) entering volume production this year. CEO C.C. Wei reiterated capex at upper end of $52-56B.

news_items.headline: Equitable Trust Co. Buys 5,326 Shares of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Ltd.
news_items.summary: 13F-style filing showing Equitable Trust Co. added 5,326 shares of TSM. Routine institutional flow disclosure.

news_items.headline: TSMC Global acquires fixed-income securities for $42.3 mln
news_items.summary: TSMC Global subsidiary disclosed a $42.3M fixed-income securities purchase. Treasury management, no operating impact.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Per TipRanks, current month shows 13 Buy / 2 Hold / 0 Sell ratings; Buy consensus reaffirmed as of 2026-05-06 across 6 analysts. Price target $416.67 implies ~0% upside from current price after this week's rally.

earnings_context.notes: Last reported Q1 2026 on 2026-04-16 (already priced in): profit +58% YoY, beat estimates; full-year 2026 revenue guidance >30% YoY USD growth; HPC segment 61% of Q1 revenue (up from 55%). Street expects continued AI-driven gross margin expansion and capacity-constrained ramp into Q2.
